title.en: know your guidefong at central market.
title.de: know your guidefong im central market.

line.en: a day of sustainable hong kong brands on the first floor of central market, from 13:00 to 19:00. the building is a restored 1939 bauhaus-style landmark, and entry to central market is free.
line.de: ein tag mit nachhaltigen marken aus hongkong im ersten stock des central market, von 13:00 bis 19:00. das gebäude ist ein restaurierter historischer bau im bauhausstil von 1939, und der eintritt ist frei.
line.tr: central market'ın birinci katında 13:00'ten 19:00'a kadar sürdürülebilir hong kong markaları günü. bina 1939 tarihli, restore edilmiş bauhaus tarzı bir yapı; girişi ücretsiz.

sparks.why: Know Your GuideFong Hong Kong on sun 8.11, 13:00-19:00, 1/F event space at Central Market, per The Beat Hong Kong and startmeup.hk. A brand market rather than a classic flea; ticket prices to be checked on the organiser's page.
